title: Feeding Our Future fraudsters sentenced to prison, ordered to pay restitution
supports: FOX 9 reported that Hussein Mohamed Farah was sentenced on 2026-08-27 to 20 months in federal prison, two years of supervised release, and $471,000 restitution for wire fraud.
FOX 9 identified New Vision Foundation as Farah's nonprofit and reported approximately $2.7 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program receipts during the charged period.
corroboration: The federal hearing calendar listed Hussein Mohamed Farah, case 25-cr-297, for sentencing before Judge Nancy E. Brasel at 10:00 a.m. on 2026-08-27.
USAO-MN's 2025-08-06 release confirms Farah was the 73rd Feeding Our Future defendant charged, by information, and identifies the New Vision Foundation $2.7 million figure.
does_not_support: Until a judgment, sentencing minute, or new USAO release is captured, the 20-month term and $471,000 restitution should not be represented as independently verified from a primary court record.
Do not use this report to change the official USAO statement that Ahmed, Ghedi, and Omar-Hashim were the 24th through 26th defendants sentenced without preserving the apparent sequencing discrepancy.
